evidence.activity: Annual paid day for employees to volunteer in their communities (Manhattan Purpose day)
evidence.quote: At Manhattan, we provide opportunities for our employees to take a full day each year to give back to their communities.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Social Responsibility

community.criterion: level 2: specific current volunteering program, no reach figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Named program that builds community partnerships for employee service (Manhattan Connect)
evidence.quote: We also give our employees multiple opportunities to serve through community partnerships that we cultivate through our Manhattan Connect™ program.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Social Responsibility

community.criterion: level 2: specific named community partnership program, no reach figures disclosed

evidence.activity: Employee learning through online platforms, external training and in-house live training
evidence.quote: To attract and retain employees, we provide competitive compensation and benefits programs, employee recognition, career development opportunities, and access to continual growth through online learning platforms, external training, and in-house live training.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Talent Acquisition, Retention, and Engagement

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: MPOWER performance management and career development program for employees
evidence.quote: Through MPOWER™, our performance management program, each employee is empowered to drive their career and gain meaningful experiences.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Career Development

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap)

evidence.activity: Employee resource groups, including a Multicultural Network, under the PRISM inclusion strategy
evidence.quote: Through PRISM, we support employee resource groups (ERGs), such as our Multicultural Network (MCNTM).
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Equal Employment Opportunity

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee networks with no membership figures

evidence.activity: Recruiting outreach to people with disabilities, veterans, HBCUs and schools with high enrollment of women and minorities
evidence.quote: Further, we promote diverse candidate pools, including individuals with disabilities and veterans, and through recruiting efforts at historically black colleges and universities (HBCUs) and schools with a high percentage of women and minorities enrolled in engineering and computer science programs.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Employees and Human Capital Management > Talent Acquisition, Retention, and Engagement

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific current inclusive recruiting practice, limited reach and no figures

evidence.quote: We also use third-party translation companies to localize our application software into various languages including Chinese, French, Japanese and Spanish.

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: multilingual product offered in several languages

evidence.activity: In-house product development and R&D on the company's own software
evidence.quote: We focus our development efforts on new product innovation and on adding new functionality to existing solutions; integrating our various solution offerings; and enhancing the operability of our solutions across our platforms.

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers supply chain, omnichannel and planning software in full and shows no creative activity.

community.reason: Level 2: named volunteering and community partnership programs plus employee development are specific and current, but no participant numbers or dollars are disclosed.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: employee resource groups with no membership figures, inclusive recruiting outreach and multilingual software localization are specific current activities of limited disclosed reach.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the filing shows only the company's own product innovation, with no service or program that enables founders or small businesses.

ai.notes: The filing points to an ESG website (manh.com/esg) for more on ESG programs, but the 10-K's own human capital section exceeds 150 words and names specific activities, so Community and Cross-cultural are sufficient and no second look is triggered. Paid customer training, change management and certification services were treated as product implementation support, not external education or an education business, so they are not scored. The Item 7 excerpt only repeats professional services training language. Trap terms were excluded: 'state-of-the-art' fulfillment, 'design' in an engineering sense, Agent Foundry (customers building AI agents is not creative work), 'foundation' meaning the technology platform, and 'Manhattan community' meaning the user-conference audience. SCALE's popularity in emerging economies and the international offices and resellers do not count as cross-cultural or entrepreneurship activity. Smaller independent companies appear only as competitors. A 'dedicated learning path' on equal employment opportunity was treated as compliance-type training and not scored. Final score = 0 + 12 + 8 + 3 = 23/100.
